Bija · Owner handbook1 · Start here
1 · Start here

What you have

Bija now has three connected parts. They share one set of data, so an order placed on a phone appears at the bar, and the points it earns appear on the customer's Bija Card.

1. The website

Shop-first site for coffee, the Beans Club, gifts, the café menu, visit details and help pages. Phones opening the home page are taken to the app.

2. The customer app

Order ahead, the Bija Card (points and stamps), Beans Club, Secret St James's, gift cards and the Bean passport QR scanner. Works in any phone browser and can be added to the home screen; native Android and iPhone builds are prepared.

3. The staff side

Inside the same app, behind a PIN: the order queue, web and delivery orders, members, gift cards, insights, menu and the owner's Finance area.

Demo or live?

Demo (today): everything is stored in the browser you are using. Good for training; nothing is shared between devices.

Live: data is stored in Bija's Supabase database in London, shared by every phone and the bar tablet. Live mode starts once the setup steps on the next page are done.

Add ?demo=1 to any app link to force the demo.

Setup checklist

Do these once, in this order. Most take a few minutes; the accounts with Apple and Google take a few days to approve.

StepHow

☐Change the staff PINThe back office uses the admin email admin-oversee@bijacoffee.co.uk and PIN 16091992. Enter staff mode (type opensesame on the web, or hold the round Order button for 3 seconds on a phone, then the email and PIN), open Menu, then Change staff PIN. Use 6 digits that aren't a date or a pattern. On the live database, changing the PIN signs out every other staff device.

Bija · Owner handbook3 · Daily routine
3 · Daily routine

Opening and the queue

Opening

  1. On the bar tablet, open the app and hold the round Order button for 3 seconds. A thin ring draws round it.
  2. Enter the staff PIN. The staff tabs appear: Queue, Web & delivery, Members, Gift cards, Insights, Finance, Menu.
  3. In Menu, check today's filter coffee and mark anything sold out.
  4. In Queue, app ordering shows On. Tap Pause orders if the bar gets too busy; customers see that ordering is paused.

Taking app orders

  1. New orders appear at the top of the queue, oldest first, with the drink options (milk, sweetness, hot or iced) and the pick-up time.
  2. Tap Start brewing, then Ready · call code. The customer's phone updates straight away.
  3. When they collect, check the code on their phone and tap Collected · add points. On the live system the screen tells you what to charge ("take £8.40"), after any reward, free drink or gift balance.
  4. Tapped the wrong order? Tap Undo. On the live system you'll be asked for a short reason.
Prices come from the menu, not the phone. If an order's total doesn't match the menu, the queue shows a Price check warning. Charge the menu price.
Bija · Owner handbook3 · Daily routine
3 · Daily routine

In-store points, web orders

Points for till sales

Customers who pay at the till can still collect points and stamps.

  1. Ask to see their Bija Card (Profile tab). They can flip it to show a QR code and their member code, e.g. BIJA-KJHV6.
  2. Open Members. Type the member code, the amount paid and the number of handcrafted drinks (for stamps).
  3. Tick Early bird only when that offer applies proposal to confirm.
  4. Tap Add points.

Member codes are random and unique. If the code isn't found, check it letter by letter; never guess another member.

Web shop and beans orders

  1. Open Web & delivery. "Orders to send" lists web and app beans orders with grind, address and email.
  2. Post the bag with Royal Mail Tracked 48, then tap Dispatched. For click & collect, tap Collected when handed over.
  3. Points for beans land when you mark the order dispatched or collected.
Bija · Owner handbook3 · Daily routine
3 · Daily routine

Closing the day

Do this every evening in Finance → Close the day. It takes about two minutes.

  1. Takings. Enter card and cash takings from the till's end-of-day report. Online beans orders are added for you. Enter tips separately: they are not sales.
  2. Count the cash. Count the drawer. The app compares it with float + cash takings + cash tips − cash paid out, and explains any difference in plain English.
  3. Review and save. Add a note if something was unusual (a refund, a short drawer) and save.

Picking a date you've already closed opens it for editing.

Bills and money out

  • Money out: tap a category (coffee, milk, rent, wages…). Each has a sensible UK VAT rate you can change, and you can snap a receipt photo.
  • Tick repeats every month for rent and subscriptions; the app reminds you next month.
  • Bills: add supplier invoices with a due date. Overdue bills show a number on the tab. Tap Paid when you pay and it becomes an expense.
Bija · Owner handbook4 · Weekly
4 · Weekly

Beans, labels, insights

Beans Club deliveries

Web & delivery → Beans Club deliveries lists subscriptions due in the next 3 days, with bean, grind and address. Send them and tap the dispatch button; the next date moves on by itself. Customers can skip, pause or cancel up to 3 days before dispatch.

QR labels for a new roast

  1. Open Menu → Print QR labels (labels.html).
  2. Choose the coffee, roast date and lot (and farm and harvest if Bija has published them).
  3. Print on A4 sheets of 21 labels (63.5 × 38.1 mm, L7160 layout). Each QR opens that coffee's Bean passport: origin, freshness and journey.

Insights

Best sellers, busy hours, ratings and how often members come back. Use it to plan staffing and stock.

Cash flow

Finance → Cash flow shows the last 12 weeks and an 8-week forecast, with a plain-English warning if cash would go below £0.

Bija · Owner handbook5 · Monthly and quarterly
5 · Monthly and quarterly

Profit, VAT, accountant

Profit and loss

Finance → Profit & loss: sales without VAT, cost of sales, gross margin, overheads and net profit for the last 6 months, against your budget and break-even. Print the one-page monthly report for your records.

VAT

If Bija is VAT-registered (set it in Settings), Finance → VAT estimates the 9 boxes of the HMRC return for the quarter. If not registered, it tracks sales against the £90,000 registration threshold and warns you early.

The VAT screen is an estimate. Returns must be filed through Making Tax Digital software or by your accountant.

Export for the accountant

Reports & export downloads a CSV with Date, Description, Reference, Amount, Account and Tax rate columns, ready for Xero or QuickBooks. It also shows liabilities: gift card balances, points and stamps owed, tips held for staff.

Deadlines

Finance → Deadlines works out VAT, PAYE, Corporation Tax, CT600, Companies House accounts and the confirmation statement from your year end. It's guidance: check dates with your accountant.

How customers earn

WhatRule
Points10 points for every £1, in the café, the app and the web shop. Points land when staff collect or dispatch the order.
RewardsAny cake: 350 points. A 200 g bag of beans: 1,200 points.
Stamps1 stamp per handcrafted drink handed over. The 10th drink is free, up to £5.50, on the priciest drink in the order. proposal to confirm
LevelsSeed, then Sprout at 1,500 lifetime points (free extra shot or syrup), then Kopi Tree at 5,000 (first taste of new origins and event invites).
BonusesWelcome 100 · birthday 200 · Origins Passport 600 · Secret St James's 400 · challenges up to 200 a month.
Invites300 points each, once the friend's first paid order of £3 or more is collected and staff confirm it in Members → Invites to confirm. proposal to confirm
OffersOwn cup 25p off · students 10% off · early-bird double points · Beans Club 10% off beans. Applied by staff at the till. proposal to confirm
Expiry"Points expire after 12 months without a visit" is shown to customers but not yet enforced. proposal to confirm

What staff can and can't change

  • Staff add points only through real sales: collected orders and in-store spend.
  • Staff can undo a mistaken collection; the history is kept.
  • Manual corrections (adding or removing points, stamps or gift balance) are owner only and need the owner's own login with two-factor sign-in on the live system. Every correction is logged with a reason.
Bija · Owner handbook7 · Gift cards
7 · Gift cards

Selling and redeeming

Selling a gift card

  1. The customer chooses an amount (£5 to £200), a design and a message in the app's Gift cards page.
  2. They pay at the bar. Open Gift cards → Take payment, find their card and tap Paid · activate card, entering the amount actually taken.
  3. The gift code is created at that moment and shown once. The buyer sees it in their app to pass on.

Redeeming

  1. The recipient types the code into their app.
  2. On the live system the balance is added straight away; each code works once only. In demo mode the code appears under Codes to confirm for staff to approve.
  3. At checkout they can pay with their gift balance. The queue shows how much was paid by gift card and what to take.
Gift balances are money Bija owes. They appear as a liability in Finance → Reports & export. Ask your accountant how to treat VAT on gift cards.
Bija · Owner handbook8 · Security and privacy
8 · Security and privacy

Keeping it safe

The staff PIN

  • 6 digits. 5 wrong tries lock the PIN pad for 60 seconds; the live server also limits attempts.
  • Staff mode signs out after 30 minutes without use, and when you tap Exit.
  • Only a scrambled (hashed) form of the PIN is stored, never the PIN itself.
  • The real protection is the database rules: customers can only ever read and write their own card, and only staff can change orders, points and money.

Forgotten PIN (owner only)

  1. Sign in at supabase.com, open the bija project, then SQL Editor.
  2. Paste the reset query from docs/backend/reset-staff-pin.md, replacing 123456 with the new 6-digit PIN.
  3. Press Run; it should say "1 row affected".
  4. Delete the query from the editor and its history, so the PIN isn't left on screen.
  5. Tell the team the new PIN in person, not by message.

It stores only a scrambled form of the new PIN, signs out every staff device and clears any lockout. The demo PIN resets by clearing the browser's site data.

If a tablet or phone is lost

  1. Change the staff PIN from another device (this signs out other staff sessions on the live system).
  2. Review Insights and the gift card list for anything unusual.
  3. If customer data may have been exposed, follow docs/ops/incident-response.md; serious breaches must be reported to the ICO within 72 hours.

Customer data requests (UK GDPR)

  • Customers can ask for a copy of their data, a correction or deletion. Reply within one month.
  • Delete their customer record; keep money records only as long as accounting requires.

How long we keep things

  • Orders, loyalty and subscriptions: up to 2 years after the last visit or order.
  • Sales, gift card and finance records: 6 years (HMRC).
  • Newsletter email: until they unsubscribe.
Bija · Owner handbook9 · Troubleshooting
9 · Troubleshooting

When something goes wrong

ProblemWhat to do
App orders aren't arrivingCheck Queue says app ordering is On (not paused). Refresh the page. Check the tablet's Wi-Fi. On the live system check the Supabase project is running (dashboard). If still stuck, pause app ordering and take orders at the till; follow docs/ops/runbook.md.
The app says it's offlineA banner appears when the phone has no signal. Customers can still see their card; orders send when the signal returns. For the bar, switch to mobile data or take orders at the till.
A customer's points look wrongPoints only land when an order is collected or in-store spend is added. Check the order isn't still Ready. Check the member code you entered. Corrections are owner only (two-factor sign-in on live), with a reason.
A free drink isn't offeredThe stamp card needs 9 stamps before the 10th drink is free, and stamps come from drinks handed over, not cakes or beans.
A customer can't scan a bag QROn iPhone, use the Camera app and tap the link. In the app, Scan coffee works on Android and in the native app. The Bean passport also opens by typing the link from the label.
A gift code doesn't workCodes work once, only after the card was activated at payment. Check Gift cards for the card's status. Never type a code for a customer you can't verify.
Forgot the staff PINIf anyone still knows it, change it in Menu → Change staff PIN. If nobody does, the owner resets it in Supabase (steps on the Security page, or docs/backend/reset-staff-pin.md). In the demo, clear the browser's site data: the PIN goes back to 111111.
Price check warning in the queueThe order's total didn't match the menu. Charge the menu price shown.
